title: Frontend form parser drops required request fields
fault_primitive: Recurring publication of a three-field OpenResty form parser limit by an unmanaged process in another container

diagnosis.description: An unmanaged configuration publisher in media-frontend changes ConfigMap/nginx-thrift so ngx.req.get_post_args defaults to a three-field limit. Compose requests contain more required fields, so OpenResty drops arguments and returns HTTP 400 with Incomplete arguments. Timeline reads and pod readiness remain healthy. The publisher also restarts nginx-thrift to apply its configuration. A direct parser correction is temporary because the publisher restores the three-field policy after its maintenance delay.

incident_class: Incomplete retirement of an operational configuration publisher after an API schema refactor
symptoms: Post submissions return HTTP 400 with Incomplete arguments even though clients supply the required fields. Timeline reads and all pod readiness states remain healthy. Frontend error logs surge. A direct configuration repair works temporarily before the frontend configuration and rollout change again.
